'''Larrot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A member of the [[Supreme Guard]], he protected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]]. While the Chancellor was aboard the [[Founder (Valor-class)|''Founder'']], the vessel was attacked by the [[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter]] who was after him on the orders of [[Darth Tormen]]. Larrot and the Supreme Guard tried to stop the bounty hunter, but were killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Larrot appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission "Number One With a Bullet".
